findings: Compared shoot detail and the spring pale cushion photograph to current small/medium/large pilots 1/4/7 and all 36 sheet entries. Unlike tree crowns, a compact mound is appropriate here: many short shoots form a continuous low cushion. The generator uses a connected ground lattice and individual tapering shoot heights rather than foliage spheres. Reference companion Polytrichum and autumn capsule stalks were not included. Heights about 0.10-0.23 m. The 3-9 mm leaves cannot resolve at 25 mm; only the cushion contour and irregular margins remain, and current broadleaf material does not reproduce its pale hydrated/dry color variation. Accepted this coarse spring cushion geometry with those explicit limits.
